entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed... it seems to be broken already.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's definitely a fault. It's just not working at all. I've charged it, I've restarted my phone, but it won't sync. I've been a loyal VeloFit user for years, and I was so excited for this, but it's completely defective.
I understand your frustration. It's certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Can I get the order number or the email address associated with your account?
Yes, it's under sarah.miller@email.com. I just... I was really counting on this, and I really needed the money back if it wasn't going to work properly.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like it was delivered 28 days ago, on December 24th. Is that correct?
Yes, that's right. It was a Christmas gift to myself. It's just so sad that it's broken.
I see. One moment while I review our return policy for this item... Okay, I've checked and you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh! Really? So I can return it?

Absolutely. Since the item is defective and you're within the timeframe, I can process a full refund for you right away. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you. Once we receive the band, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method.
Wow, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great rest of your day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
